title: Work modes: Auto, Planning and Development
summary: Each chat has a work mode: Planning only reads the project and answers with a plan, Development changes files, and Auto lets Jev choose for each request.
usage: Pick the mode under the message box, start a message with /plan, /build or /auto, or press Ctrl+. (⌘. on Mac). If a Planning chat asks to implement, Jev switches it to Development. In Development, the agent ends with what it ran, what it assumes and what it didn't verify. A permission you grant in the chat also applies in Auto: the request goes to Development so the agent can use it. A chat pinned to Planning stays read-only. A mode you pick while a request runs is kept.
